items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to a hip injury; McVay notes not long-term but cautious, limited progress.
items.implication: Unlikely to play Week 3; monitor Friday

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins did not practice for the second straight day with a hamstring injury.
items.implication: Long shot for Sunday vs Colts
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for Dalton Schultz and other HOU pass-catchers

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after expected knee surgery (MCL/meniscus, ACL intact); season-ending for regular season, possible playoff return remote.
items.implication: Season over; Giants QB carousel, impacts entire NYG offense including Nabers/Skattebo
items.opportunity: Jameis Winston or other QB elevated; more run-heavy or checkdowns possible

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers missed practice for the second straight day with hamstring; looking like second consecutive miss, Brazil trip complicates.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated; origin Aug 20 joint practice
items.implication: Expected out Week 3 vs DAL in Brazil
items.opportunity: More work for other BAL WRs/TEs like Mark Andrews/Isaiah Likely

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) on practice field after good MRI results; expects to play Monday vs Bears. Limited participation expected.
items.why: MRI went well, practicing with protective device
items.implication: Likely starts MNF; monitor snap share if limited
items.opportunity: Full workload preferred over Bigsby/Shipley handcuffs

items.text: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks placed on IR (groin/core muscle surgery, min 6 weeks); Chuba Hubbard firmly in lead back role with AJ Dillon backup.
items.implication: Hubbard clear lead RB; high utilization

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert expected to miss a few weeks with MCL sprain (avoided short-term IR); DNP Thursday.
items.implication: Miss MNF and possibly more; Mundt/Jenkins elevated
items.opportunity: Increased TE targets to backups or WRs like DeVonta Smith

items.text: TNF spots: Has Marshawn Lloyd ceded to Kaleb Johnson? Can healthy Penix revive Drake London/Kyle Pitts? Reed absence more 2-TE for Packers? Watson/Golden cook vs weak OL?
items.why: Role/usage questions on key absences and returns
items.implication: London/Pitts upside with Penix; Watson if Reed out; monitor Lloyd snaps
items.opportunity: Pass-game revival ATL; 2TE GB or Watson routes

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 42%; results include 8-195-2 vs NYG. Strong standalone without Nacua.
items.why: High route/target share and production in Nacua absences
items.implication: Adams WR1/elite play if Nacua out

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush prop 88.5, Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor DAL run D, high prop
items.opportunity: Volume and yards upside in Brazil

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches +15% tgt share both games, RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit tgts both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: High volume/air yards + soft LV secondary

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there (RB37 util).
